Name: Cap Mouse - A Custom NPC
Author: ElinHime
Description:
Come meet the Cap Mouse!
She is hanging out outside the old old old haus and will help you with all your hat-related questions. No coines necessary.




This mod was made for the Stardew Discord "Hat Mouse Summer Fashion" Event.

It's made in Miss Coriel's NPC Creator and is my first attempt at making a mod. So it's quite simple.
You have my blanket permission to do whatever you like with this mod. 

[b]Should be compatible with just about all mods.[/b]

[size=3]~ Installation ~[/size]
1. Download and unzip
2. Place folder in your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder
3. Run game with SMAPI

Downloads.Description:
Cap Mouse - A Custom NPC


She apparently went on a little walk without telling me, but is now back again in front of Hat Mouses home. She is very sorry about being gone for so long.
